alerts.reason: March-quarter net sales fell 0.7% year over year. Chassis and component shortages reduced Work Truck Solutions deliveries, and Work Truck Attachments also sold fewer units (A–C). I forecast a June-quarter decline of less than 5%, followed by a decline of at least 5% in the September quarter as shortages continue to limit deliveries.

NN reported weaker demand across multiple regions even with all locations operating (B). Lower sales volume and supply interruptions contributed to a $4.1 million drop in operating income (C). I forecast that reported sales growth stays above −5% in the June quarter and crosses to −5% or worse in the September quarter as weaker orders translate into shipments. The timing is uncertain because the records give no consolidated sales growth rate.

March-quarter revenue grew 6.4%, supported by cloud adoption and on-premise license demand (A–B). Deferred revenue nevertheless fell $99.5 million from December, including $63.6 million in maintenance and support and $35.9 million in subscriptions (C). I forecast that current demand keeps June-quarter growth above −5%, but the smaller deferred balance leaves less revenue to recognize in the September quarter, when I expect a decline of at least 5%.

March-quarter net revenue grew 4.8% year over year, from $173.7 million to $182.1 million (A). Communications revenue was already falling as cellphone customers had bought heavily a year earlier to capture a competitor’s business (B). I forecast consolidated growth above −5% in June, followed by a decline of at least 5% in September if weaker cellphone orders outweigh growth elsewhere.
